scientificExplanation.simpleExplanation: Glutathione is a naturally occurring antioxidant in the body that helps protect cells from damage caused by harmful substances called free radicals.
scientificExplanation.professionalExplanation: Glutathione (GSH) is a tripeptide composed of glutamate, cysteine, and glycine. It is the predominant non-enzymatic antioxidant in mammalian cells, existing primarily in reduced (GSH) and oxidized (GSSG) forms. GSH participates in cellular redox homeostasis, xenobiotic metabolism, and protection against oxidative stress through multiple enzymatic pathways including glutathione peroxidase and glutathione S-transferase systems.

sources.title: Glutathione Metabolism and Its Implications for Health

scientificExplanation.limitations: Individual responses to oral glutathione supplementation vary. Bioavailability and clinical outcomes depend on multiple factors including baseline glutathione status, oxidative stress burden, and overall nutritional state.

scientificExplanation.simpleExplanation: Astaxanthin is a red-orange pigment found in algae and seafood that acts as a powerful antioxidant to help protect cells from damage.
scientificExplanation.professionalExplanation: Astaxanthin is a xanthophyll carotenoid with potent antioxidant properties. It is naturally synthesized by microalgae (Haematococcus pluvialis) and accumulates in aquatic organisms. The conjugated double-bond structure enables astaxanthin to neutralize singlet oxygen and peroxyl radicals. Research suggests astaxanthin may support skin health through antioxidant mechanisms, though clinical outcomes vary.
scientificExplanation.limitations: Optimal dosing, long-term safety, and specific clinical outcomes require further research. Results may vary based on individual factors.

scientificExplanation.simpleExplanation: NAC provides the body with cysteine, which is used to make glutathione, helping support the body's natural antioxidant system.
scientificExplanation.professionalExplanation: N-acetyl-L-cysteine is a modified form of the amino acid cysteine with enhanced stability. Cysteine availability is often the rate-limiting factor in glutathione biosynthesis. NAC serves as a cysteine donor, potentially supporting endogenous glutathione synthesis through the γ-glutamylcysteine synthetase and glutathione synthetase enzymatic pathway. NAC also exhibits direct antioxidant properties through its free thiol group.
scientificExplanation.limitations: The extent to which oral NAC increases tissue glutathione levels varies among individuals and tissues.

scientificExplanation.simpleExplanation: Vitamin C works together with glutathione to provide antioxidant protection and supports the body's collagen production.
scientificExplanation.professionalExplanation: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C) functions as a water-soluble antioxidant and participates in the regeneration of oxidized glutathione (GSSG) back to reduced glutathione (GSH) through enzymatic and non-enzymatic mechanisms. Vitamin C is also an essential cofactor for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylase enzymes involved in collagen biosynthesis. The combination of vitamin C with glutathione represents a synergistic antioxidant approach addressing multiple redox pathways.
scientificExplanation.limitations: Clinical benefits depend on baseline vitamin C status and individual health factors.

scientificExplanation.simpleExplanation: Effervescent tablets dissolve in water, creating a fizzy drink that is easy and convenient to consume.
scientificExplanation.professionalExplanation: Effervescent formulations utilize acid-base reactions (typically citric acid and sodium bicarbonate) to facilitate rapid dissolution and potentially enhance palatability. While some literature suggests effervescent formats may improve absorption for certain nutrients, definitive bioavailability advantages depend on the specific active ingredients and individual factors.
scientificExplanation.evidenceLevel: Format convenience established; bioavailability advantages vary
scientificExplanation.limitations: Claims of superior absorption should be supported by product-specific pharmacokinetic data.

faq.question: What is X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is an effervescent antioxidant nutraceutical tablet containing L-Glutathione (500 mg), Astaxanthin (6 mg), N-Acetyl L-Cysteine (50 mg), and Vitamin C (40 mg). It is designed to support the body's natural antioxidant defence and promote skin health through nutritional support.

faq.question: What are the ingredients in X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB contains: L-Glutathione 500 mg, Astaxanthin 6 mg, N-Acetyl L-Cysteine (NAC) 50 mg, and Vitamin C 40 mg per tablet.

faq.question: How does glutathione work?
faq.answer: Glutathione is a naturally occurring antioxidant in the body that helps protect cells from oxidative damage. It exists in reduced (GSH) and oxidized (GSSG) forms and participates in cellular redox balance. It works through enzymatic systems to neutralize harmful reactive species and support cellular health.

faq.question: Why is NAC included in the formula?
faq.answer: NAC (N-Acetyl L-Cysteine) provides cysteine, which is a key building block needed by the body to make its own glutathione. Cysteine availability is often the limiting factor in glutathione production, so NAC helps support the body's endogenous glutathione synthesis pathway.

faq.question: What is astaxanthin?
faq.answer: Astaxanthin is a powerful carotenoid antioxidant naturally found in microalgae. It has a unique molecular structure that helps protect cells from oxidative stress. In X-GLUTA TAB, it provides complementary antioxidant support alongside glutathione.

faq.question: Is X-GLUTA TAB a medicine or supplement?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is a nutraceutical (dietary supplement), not a medicine. However, professional guidance is recommended for optimal use. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

faq.question: Does X-GLUTA TAB whiten skin?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB provides antioxidant nutritional support that may contribute to healthier-looking, more radiant skin. However, it does not guarantee skin whitening, permanent skin color change, or fairness. Individual results vary based on many factors including genetics, sun exposure, and overall health. It should not be viewed as a skin bleaching agent.

faq.question: How is X-GLUTA TAB different from X-GLUTA IV?
faq.answer: X-GLUTA TAB is an oral effervescent tablet taken by mouth, while X-GLUTA IV is an injectable formulation administered intravenously by qualified healthcare professionals. The oral route passes through the digestive system, while IV administration delivers the ingredients directly into the bloodstream. The IV products are prescription-only and require medical supervision, while the TAB is a nutraceutical for general use with professional guidance recommended.

faq.question: How many tablets are in one pack?
faq.answer: One pack of X-GLUTA TAB contains 30 effervescent tablets, packaged as 2 tubes with 15 tablets each.

faq.question: How should I take X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: Dissolve 1 effervescent tablet in a glass of water and consume daily, or as directed by a healthcare professional. The effervescent format makes it easy and convenient to take.

faq.question: Can everyone take X-GLUTA TAB?
faq.answer: While X-GLUTA TAB is generally well-tolerated, you should consult a healthcare professional before use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medications, or have any medical conditions. Do not use if you have a known allergy to any ingredient.

faq.question: What precautions should I follow?
faq.answer: Follow the label instructions, consult a healthcare professional if you have medical conditions or are taking medications, keep out of reach of children, and store in a cool, dry place. Discontinue use if you experience any adverse reactions.

faq.question: Is it safe during pregnancy?
faq.answer: If you are pregnant or nursing, please consult your healthcare professional before using X-GLUTA TAB or any dietary supplement.

faq.question: Will it work for everyone?
faq.answer: Individual results may vary. X-GLUTA TAB provides antioxidant nutritional support, but outcomes depend on many factors including baseline nutritional status, lifestyle, genetics, and overall health. It is not a guaranteed treatment and does not replace a healthy lifestyle or medical care.

faq.question: Can I take it with other supplements?
faq.answer: Please consult your healthcare professional before combining X-GLUTA TAB with other supplements or medications to ensure safety and avoid potential interactions.

generalScience.simpleExplanation: Oxidative stress occurs when there are too many harmful molecules called 'free radicals' in the body and not enough antioxidants to neutralize them. This imbalance can damage cells.
generalScience.professionalExplanation: Oxidative stress represents an imbalance between the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and the biological system's ability to neutralize these reactive intermediates through antioxidant defences. ROS include superoxide anion, hydrogen peroxide, and hydroxyl radical. While ROS play physiological signaling roles, excessive accumulation can damage lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids, potentially contributing to various pathological processes.

sources.title: Free Radicals and Antioxidants in Normal Physiological Functions

generalScience.simpleExplanation: Antioxidants are substances that help protect the body's cells from damage caused by harmful molecules. They work like shields to keep cells healthy.
generalScience.professionalExplanation: Antioxidants are molecules capable of inhibiting the oxidation of other molecules by donating electrons to free radicals, thereby neutralizing their reactivity. The body's antioxidant system includes enzymatic defences (superoxide dismutase, catalase, glutathione peroxidase) and non-enzymatic defences (glutathione, vitamin C, vitamin E, carotenoids). These systems work synergistically to maintain cellular redox homeostasis.
